verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Claude can be used in the terminal to write, review, and ship code. Community users independently describe Claude Code as an interactive CLI and bash tool they run alongside Vim, and one user's empty, unresponsive first session is a single anecdote that does not contradict the CLI's existence. missing for 10: in-depth first-party CLI documentation (installation, commands, non-interactive or scripted use), richer hands-on corroboration of reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use Claude in your terminal to write, review, and ship code.

shipping it as an interactive CLI instead of an extension
